FACT-2.gloss: The lemon tree has initial investment of 90

FACT-3.gloss: The lemon tree yields 7 lemons per year

RULE-1.gloss: Annual revenue equals the product of lemons per year and price per lemon when those values and their product are known
RULE-1.formula: ∀t∀l∀p∀r((LemonsPerYear(t, l) ∧ PricePerLemon(p) ∧ Product(l, p, r)) → AnnualRevenue(t, r))

RULE-2.gloss: Net profit per year is the difference between AnnualRevenue and WateringCostPerYear when those values are known
RULE-2.formula: ∀t∀r∀c∀n((AnnualRevenue(t, r) ∧ WateringCostPerYear(t, c) ∧ Difference(r, c, n)) → NetProfitPerYear(t, n))

RULE-3.gloss: Years to profit is the quotient of InitialInvestment and NetProfitPerYear when those values are known
RULE-3.formula: ∀t∀i∀n∀y((InitialInvestment(t, i) ∧ NetProfitPerYear(t, n) ∧ Quotient(i, n, y)) → YearsToProfit(t, y))

RULE-4.gloss: If lemons per year and price per lemon are known, then there exists a Product representing their product
